name: Starlight Mosaic Library
description: A library whose walls are mosaics of tiny mirrors reflecting starlight, each book glowing with constellations.
prompt: An expansive library with towering shelves. Walls are covered in intricate mosaics of tiny mirrors that catch and reflect starlight from a glass ceiling. Books emit a faint glow, their covers displaying moving constellations. Quiet, magical, 8k.
caption: Read the stories written in stars. 📚✨
